name: cfmeeting
description: CFMeeting — open-source video meeting demo built on Cloudflare RealtimeKit (community derivative of the official Cloudflare Realtime demo).

scripts.deploy: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run deploy -w apps/server
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build:packaged -w apps/web && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:packaged -w apps/web && npm run sync -w apps/android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && npm run build:apk -w apps/android
scripts.icons: node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && npm run assets -w apps/android
